title: Cartan's and Gauss's equations and rigidity theorems for isometric embeddings in low Sobolev regularity
summary: Let $\{η^i\}_{i=1}^2$ be a an orthonormal coframe on a domain $U$ on a smooth surface $(Σ,g)$. When $η^i$ is smooth, it is well-known that there is a unique connection 1-form $ω$ verifying Cartan's first structural equations $dη^i = (*η^i) \wedge ω$, and Cartan's second structural equation $dω= K_g dvol_g$. We prove that this statement remains valid when the frame is $C^0 \cap H^{\frac12}$, where the structural equations are understood in the sense of distributions.
